youtube.description:
Count from one to ten with Robo's drum! Sing This Old Man with Robo the drummer: he played one, knick-knack on my thumb, two on my shoe, three on my knee, all the way to ten on my hen. For every number the number block pops up, we hold up our fingers and count, and then guess the rhyme: two... what rhymes with two? Shoe! Watch the number tracker fill from 1 to 10, meet the surprise friend at ten, play a point-to-it rhyme game, and sing the whole song once more with the dog and his bone.

What your child learns: counting from 1 to 10 on their fingers, the numbers 1 to 10 in order, and rhyming words (two and shoe, four and door, ten and hen).

Sing at home: hold up a finger for each number, tap knick-knack on your knees like a drum, and pause before each rhyme so your child can shout it: "Two... what rhymes with two?" This Old Man is a traditional public-domain song; Robo sings "This Robo" in place of "This old man", and two gentle word swaps (seven/oven, nine/line) replace the old lines.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
